02 / Working approach

From a workflow
to working evidence.

I connect business context with the interface, data rules and delivery work. The useful details include how a change behaves when inputs are incomplete, requests compete or a service fails.

01 — Understand

Define the need

Identify the users, information and decisions the change needs to support. Agree what a usable result looks like.

02 — Design

Make the rules explicit

Map state, data and permissions. Decide how to handle exceptions and what must remain consistent.

03 — Build & verify

Check the behaviour

Inspect normal inputs and failure paths. Keep implementation tests distinct from deployed acceptance.

04 — Handover

Leave a clear next step

Explain what works, what it assumes and where it stops. Keep release evidence and operating guidance close to the work.

Technical judgement

The case studies explain implementation choices and trade-offs, with the current stage visible. A public website, a tested demonstration and an accepted business workflow each need their own evidence.

I translate requirements into development priorities, API specifications and acceptance checks. I investigate data gaps, reconcile records across systems and prepare service, compliance and executive reporting that supports informed decisions.

My development work includes full-stack applications, a cross-platform game with an Android release candidate, custom WordPress themes and plugins, WooCommerce workflows, API integration, logos and brand identity.
